question_text: Outline two cleaning operations needed when customer records from several sources will train a prediction model.
adaptation_rationale: Retains cleaning reasoning but avoids unsupported ETL implementation detail; supplies ML training context.
solution: Standardize equivalent date/category formats so values are comparable. Detect and consolidate duplicate observations so repeated records do not over-weight training.
